notes:
Beta 1.5.15 - proactive badge patching in update batches.

Fix: badge in user profiles and channel headers still flickered because users/chats inside the processUpdates batch were applied to the cache before our post-update patch ran. Now ProcessUpdatesWearHook.before walks every update batch and applies server badges to users/chats inline, so Telegram caches them already patched. Combined with the existing after-batch repatch, the badge no longer drops on incoming updates.
